full_prompt_en: A square, cleanly painted graphic scene shows four people and a small dog walking along an orange sidewalk before a flat turquoise wall. A narrow band across the top reveals dark green trees and a warm yellow opening between them, separated from the walkers by the wall's straight upper edge. The group moves toward the left across the lower middle of the selected panel. At the front, a person in a mustard-orange shirt and dark knee-length bottoms wears a rounded dark green head covering with a protruding face piece; the eyes and mouth are hidden. Immediately behind, an older white-haired man wears a light short-sleeved shirt, tan trousers, and dark shoes. A white-haired woman in a yellow-green outfit follows close to his right, and a smaller dark-haired child in a pale yellow top and blue bottoms reaches toward the adults from behind. A tiny teal dog trots at the rear near the child's feet. Their legs overlap in a repeated walking rhythm, but the bodies are separated by clear color blocks and crisp outlines. Along the bottom, a gray curb of rectangular segments divides the orange walkway from a deeper orange strip below. Light appears bright and even, leaving only small dark shapes around shoes and almost no soft shading on the wall. Subtle grain across the flat fields keeps the paint surface from looking perfectly digital. The overall composition is an orderly horizontal procession, whose cheerful color and unsettling covered face create a dry, strange mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、绘制干净的图形化场景呈现四个人和一只小狗沿橙色人行道行走，后面是平坦的青绿色墙面。上方一条狭窄区域露出深绿树木及树间暖黄色开口，墙面笔直的上缘把它同路人分开。所选单图中，这一行人从下部中央朝左走。最前面的人穿芥末橙色上衣和深色及膝下装，头上有圆润的深绿遮盖物和向前突出的面部部件；眼睛与嘴巴都被遮住。紧随其后的是一名白发年长男子，穿浅色短袖衬衣、棕褐长裤和深色鞋子。一名白发女子穿黄绿色衣服，靠在他的右侧同行，后面较小的黑发孩子穿浅黄色上衣和蓝色下装，向成年人伸出手。小小的青绿色狗在队尾、孩子脚边小跑。他们的腿部在重复的步行节奏里相互遮叠，但身体仍由清楚的色块和锐利轮廓区分。底部由长方形分段组成的灰色路缘，将橙色步道与下方更深的橙色带分开。光线明亮而均匀，只在鞋旁留下小块深色，墙上几乎没有柔和的明暗变化。平涂区域中细微颗粒让颜料表面不至于显得完全数字化。整体构图是一列有序的水平行人，明快色彩与令人不安的遮面人物合起来，形成冷幽默般奇异的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Clean figurative painting uses broad matte color fields, crisp contours, and a thin layer of fine surface grain. Saturated turquoise, orange, mustard yellow, and teal are divided into large horizontal zones, while small dark shapes punctuate their edges. Forms are simplified into readable silhouettes, with shallow overlap supplying depth instead of extensive modeling. The lighting is bright and even, so shadows remain compact and local rather than spreading across the field. Straight bands and repeated upright intervals create an orderly visual pace; tiny organic marks in a narrow upper zone soften the geometry. Color stays cheerful even when the arrangement feels emotionally distant or odd. The overall effect is flat, precise, and quietly surreal.
style_prompt_zh: 干净的具象绘画使用宽阔的哑光色面、清晰轮廓和一层细微表面颗粒。饱和的青绿、橙色、芥末黄及蓝绿被划分为大块水平区域，少量深色形体点在边缘。形体被简化成易读的剪影，以浅层遮叠而非大量塑形提供纵深。光线明亮均匀，阴影因而保持紧凑、局部，不向整个色域蔓延。笔直的横带和重复的直立间隔形成有序节奏；上方狭窄区域里的细小有机笔痕使几何形态稍显柔和。即使画面安排带有疏离或怪异感，色彩仍然明快。整体效果平面、精确，并带有安静的超现实意味。
theme_en: Four walkers and a small dog pass a turquoise wall
theme_zh: 四名行人与一只小狗走过青绿色墙面
